# Actual PointCeil probe supplement

This additive old-probe oracle borrows the actual returned PointCeil domain and
its private Structural AudioSignal after set_evaluation. It reuses the existing
16-case capture/probe producer once per invocation. All 128 old observations
and every immutable v1 metadata field remain literal-equal to the original
owner-capture-baseline-v1 golden. Variant and source-authority strings identify
each actual build/run.

The one exercised Point result is retained_point_voice, work21. The snapshot
records every private Point/Structural signal field using exact ratios and
stable node IDs. It does not clone signal(), issue another query or probe,
or reconstruct a Domain. Other providers and Empty raw domains are unexercised.

Observers allocate while values live. This is logical/work/error evidence,
not admission, allocation-peak, native/RSS, source/provider or cold qualification.
The earlier golden remains unchanged; never regenerate expected legacy values
to accommodate a new implementation.
